cues.show: You with the guitar, the whole neck on screen with one position framed.
cues.say: This is the whole neck with the notes of the scale. The same notes repeat all the way along it.

cues.show: Point at the frame, then at the faint notes outside it.
cues.say: The frame is one position: the part of the neck your hand covers without moving. The faint notes outside it belong to the other positions.

cues.show: Press Play, then play the framed position on the guitar.
cues.say: Press Play below to hear the framed notes up and back down. Then play them on the guitar, one finger for each fret.

cues.show: Press another position in the row under the neck. Play that one.
cues.say: Under the neck is a row of positions. Press one to frame it on the neck.

cues.show: Press another position in the row under the neck. Play that one.
cues.say: This one starts where the last one ended, so the two share a row of notes.

cues.show: Play up one position, slide on one string, carry on in the next.
cues.say: To get from one position to the next, slide one finger along a string to a note the next position has, and carry on from there.

cues.show: Play up one position, slide on one string, carry on in the next.
cues.say: Practice until you can move between two positions without stopping the line.

cues.show: Press two positions so both are framed. Play one note on one string all the way up the neck.
cues.say: Try things with it. Frame two positions next to each other and play through both as one long scale.

cues.show: Press two positions so both are framed. Play one note on one string all the way up the neck.
cues.say: Play along a single string, from the first fret as high as you can go, using only the dots.

cues.show: Press two positions so both are framed. Play one note on one string all the way up the neck.
cues.say: Find the ringed note in every position: it is the same note, higher each time.
